ns2:section.sectionText: Addresses technical and soft skills in managing computer-based research. Relevant to both technical and newly technical student researchers from disciplines across campus. This course will cover data management; process management and task automation; and research project management. Topics include data organization in spreadsheets, document revision control, data visualization, robust testing strategies, and reproducibility.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
